courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Intensive Turkish I
courses.description: Not open to native speakers of Turkish. First semester of intensive Turkish language instruction. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Turkish 601C and 506 may not both be counted. Turkish 601C and 507 may not both be counted.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: First-Year Turkish I
courses.description: Modern Standard Turkish. Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Turkish 601C and 506 may not both be counted.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: First-Year Turkish II
courses.description: Modern Standard Turkish. Continuation of Turkish 506. Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Turkish 601C and 507 may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Turkish 506 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Turkish 506 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Intensive Turkish II
courses.description: Not open to native speakers of Turkish. Second semester of intensive Turkish language instruction. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Turkish 611C and 412K may not both be counted. Turkish 611C and 412L may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Turkish 601C or 507 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Turkish 601C or 507 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Second-Year Turkish I
courses.description: Conversational Turkish and readings in contemporary Turkish literature and newspapers. Review of the grammar covered in Turkish 506 and 507, and introduction of more complex grammatical patterns. Four lecture hours a week for one semester. Turkish 611C and 412K may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Turkish 601C or 507 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Turkish 601C or 507 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Second-Year Turkish II
courses.description: Continuation of Turkish 412K. Four lecture hours a week for one semester. Turkish 611C and 412L may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Turkish 412K with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Turkish 412K with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Topics in Turkish
courses.description: This course is used to record credit the student earns while enrolled at another institution in a program administered by the University's Study Abroad Office. Credit is recorded as assigned by the study abroad adviser in the Department of Middle Eastern Studies. University credit is awarded for work in an exchange program; it may be counted as coursework taken in residence. Transfer credit is awarded for work in an affiliated studies program. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Intermediate Turkish I
courses.description: Not open to native speakers of Turkish. Intermediate to high-level Turkish in four basic language skills: speaking, listening, reading, and writing. Turkish culture. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Turkish 611C or 412L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Turkish 611C or 412L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Intermediate Turkish II
courses.description: Not open to native speakers of Turkish. Continuation of Turkish 320K. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Turkish 320K with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Turkish 320K with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Advanced Turkish I
courses.description: Restricted to nonnative speakers of Turkish. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Turkish 325K and 329 (Topic: Advanced Turkish I) may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Turkish 320L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Turkish 320L with a grade of at least C.
courses.restricted: Restricted to nonnative speakers of Turkish.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Advanced Turkish II
courses.description: Restricted to nonnative speakers of Turkish. Advanced Turkish language instruction. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Turkish 325L and 329 (Topic: Advanced Turkish II) may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Turkish 325K or the equivalent.
courses.prereqText: Turkish 325K or the equivalent.
courses.restricted: Restricted to nonnative speakers of Turkish.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Topics in Turkish Language, Literature, and Culture
courses.description: Conducted in Turkish. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Upper-division standing and Turkish 611C or 412L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Upper-division standing and Turkish 611C or 412L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Turkish Cinema
courses.description: Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Turkish 329 (Topic: Turkish Cinema) and 329C may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Turkish 611C or 412L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Turkish 611C or 412L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Turkish Society and Culture
courses.description: Explore aspects of contemporary Turkish society and culture while building intercultural communicative competence in modern Turkish through listening, speaking, reading, and writing activities in and outside of class. Focus on daily life and material culture, and guides students to develop efficient reading, listening, and viewing strategies. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Turkish 329 (Topic: Turkish Society and Culture) and 329D may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Upper-division standing, and Turkish 611C or 412L with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Upper-division standing, and Turkish 611C or 412L with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Turkish across Disciplines
courses.description: Students read and discuss Turkish language materials related to the subject matter of another designated course. One lecture hour a week for one semester. No more than three semester hours may be counted toward the major in either Middle Eastern Studies or Middle Eastern Languages and Culture. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Upper-division standing, Turkish 320L, and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Upper-division standing, Turkish 320L, and consent of instructor.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Conference Course in Turkish Language and Literature
courses.description: Supervised individual study of selected problems in Turkish language or literature. Conference course. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Upper-division standing and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Upper-division standing and consent of instructor.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Topics in Turkish Language and Literature
courses.description: Study of various aspects or eras of Turkish language and literature. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing, and Turkish 412L or the equivalent.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing, and Turkish 412L or the equivalent.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Intensive Graduate Language Instruction I
courses.description: Intensive cultural and literacy-focused training in Turkish at the beginning level in preparation for research in the Turkic-speaking world or with Turkish sources. Incoming students are placed in the appropriate level by means of a departmental placement test. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Intensive Graduate Language Instruction II
courses.description: Intensive cultural and literacy-focused training in Turkish at the low-intermediate level in preparation for research in the Turkic-speaking world or with Turkish sources. Incoming students are placed in the appropriate level by means of a departmental placement test. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and Turkish 381H with a grade of at least B.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and Turkish 381H with a grade of at least B.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Intermediate Graduate Language Instruction I
courses.description: Intensive cultural and literacy-focused training in Turkish at the intermediate level in preparation for research in the Turkic-speaking world or with Turkish sources. Includes an independent project component. Incoming students are placed in the appropriate level by means of a departmental placement test. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and Turkish 381J with a grade of at least B.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and Turkish 381J with a grade of at least B.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Intermediate Graduate Language Instruction II
courses.description: Intensive cultural and literacy-focused training in Turkish at the high-intermediate level in preparation for research in the Turkic-speaking world or with Turkish sources. Includes an independent project component. Incoming students are placed in the appropriate level by means of a placement test. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and Turkish 381K with a grade of at least B.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and Turkish 381K with a grade of at least B.

courses.subject: TUR
courses.title: Advanced Language Instruction I
courses.description: Restricted to non-native speakers of Turkish. Intensive cultural and literacy-focused training in Turkish at the advanced level in preparation for research in the Turkic-speaking world or with Turkish sources. Incoming students are placed in the appropriate level by means of a departmental placement test. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and Turkish 381L or the equivalent with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and Turkish 381L or the equivalent with a grade of at least C.
courses.restricted: Restricted to non-native speakers of Turkish.

courses.title: Conference Course in Turkish Studies
courses.description: Supervised individual study of selected problems in Turkish studies. The equivalent of three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Graduate standing, consent of the graduate adviser, and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing, consent of the graduate adviser, and consent of instructor.
